development_findings: NetBSD rc.subr requires command registration for its status keyword even with status_cmd; fixed and worker regression repeated.
NetBSD pgrep -x matches the full executable path in this fixture; corrected lifecycle process assertions.

The hostile-peer harness originally blocked in host os.write; final driver uses nonblocking writes, keeps the independent useful-peer latency check, discards queued attack input and verifies a fresh useful login. Interrupted/backlogged harness attempts are not counted as passed application campaigns.
Build verification exposed omitted embedded SQL inputs; original merge-revision schemas were added to the buildable historical snapshot without changing old result files.
